name: synefields
description:
synefields is a room for your daily 5-minute (box) breathing routine. Explore 6 different worlds to breathe in on your journey to calmness.

The additional NFT collection offers 80 unique breathing fields – sixteen in each of five worlds. Each field has its own bespoke audio, colour palette and movement.
